Before we begin

A few useful details.

What should we include in our brief?

Property location, areas to photograph, preferred dates, intended usage and the visual references you have in mind.

How are production and travel planned?

These are discussed for each commission. The scope, crew requirements and schedule are agreed before a booking is confirmed.

Can we discuss photography and film together?

Yes. Include both in your brief so the production requirements can be considered together.
